# canary

> The app-health / errors / uptime / observability employee for AI agents —
> the early warning that's actually actionable: instrument once, page on
> symptoms, prove the page delivers. Powered by Energy. canary is a
> domain-expert employee: it owns errors, uptime, latency, release-health, SLO /
> error-budget burn-rate, structured logs, and on-call with restraint, on an
> instrument-once OpenTelemetry substrate — and it refuses the footguns that
> silently corrupt every downstream signal.

## The one boundary (read this first)

**App health ONLY. LLM token spend is agentmoney's.** canary reads
`gen_ai.client.operation.duration` / `.exception` / `error.type` off a GenAI
span and **stops** at `gen_ai.usage.*`. canary and agentmoney read **disjoint
attribute sets off the SAME OpenTelemetry GenAI span** (shared tag
`gen_ai.request.model`). canary never holds a cost or token metric.
(`brain/EXPERTISE-MAP.md` JOB 0.)

## The default stack (locked — `brain/TOOL-MATRIX.md`)

**OpenTelemetry** (instrument-once substrate) · **Sentry** (errors + traces +
release-health + Seer) · **Prometheus + Grafana** (metrics + SLO / MWMBR
burn-rate) · **Checkly** (synthetic / uptime, monitoring-as-code) · **pino**
(structured logs) · **PagerDuty / incident.io** (on-call) · **BetterStack**
(uptime alt). Defaults are wired; alts are documented, not wired.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md): how an agent consumes canary (CLI commands, MCP tools, when to call which, what it refuses).
- [identity/SOUL.md](./identity/SOUL.md): who canary is — the creed ("page on symptoms, delete alerts, test delivery, causality over volume"), what it IS / DOES / REFUSES.
- [brain/OPINIONS.md](./brain/OPINIONS.md): the stances a consuming agent should adopt (page on symptoms not causes, the senior move is to DELETE an alert, test the delivery path, never average a percentile, never alert on a rate without a volume floor).

## Brain (the expertise — cite these)

- [brain/MOC - canary.md](./brain/MOC%20-%20canary.md): the brain index — the master hub for all six artifacts.
- [brain/EXPERTISE-MAP.md](./brain/EXPERTISE-MAP.md): the 10 JOBS — start here; JOB 0 = the agentmoney boundary.
- [brain/BATTLE-TESTED-SCENARIOS.md](./brain/BATTLE-TESTED-SCENARIOS.md): S1–S18 real failure/migration cases (symptom → diagnosis → resolution → verify); each is a golden eval with a binary VERIFY.
- [brain/KNOWN-PITFALLS.md](./brain/KNOWN-PITFALLS.md): §1–§12 version-specific footguns, each with detection + avoidance.
- [brain/TOOL-MATRIX.md](./brain/TOOL-MATRIX.md): per-tool default vs alt, the agent-access surface (MCP/CLI/REST), required secrets.
- [brain/GAPS-AND-DISPUTES.md](./brain/GAPS-AND-DISPUTES.md): live disputes (both sides), what's unconfirmed (say "re-verify").

## Tools (CLI commands)

`instrument` · `slo` · `audit` · `check-delivery` · `cardinality` · `brain` ·
`explain`. Honest stubs (advertised in `--help`, not yet delivered):
`release-health` · `uptime` · `eval`. Run `canary --help` for the CLI; exit 0 on
success, non-zero on error; `--json` on every data command for agent consumption.

## MCP (canary's OWN server)

canary ships its own MCP server (stdio local + a documented Streamable-HTTP path)
exposing the expertise operations: `instrument_service` · `scaffold_slo` ·
`audit_observability` · `check_delivery` · `release_health` (planned —
Sentry-creds-gated) · `detect_cardinality` · `explain_pitfall` · `search_brain`.
This is **distinct** from the *consumed* obs-query MCPs (`sentry`, `grafana`,
`prometheus`) that canary uses as query lenses (OPINIONS D1) — those are
registered in `.mcp.json` with **env refs only**, never live keys. The A2A card
is at [.well-known/agent.json](./.well-known/agent.json).

## Skills (repo-authored, each cites a brain node)

- instrument-with-otel · slo-burn-rate-alerting · test-alert-delivery (the
  differentiator) · fix-source-maps · tame-cardinality-and-percentiles
  (see `skills/<name>/SKILL.md`).

## Sub-agents

- `observability-auditor` (audits instrumentation config footguns — source-map
  Debug IDs §1, `tracesSampleRate` §1b.3, ad-blocker `tunnel` §1b.2, the v9
  `autoSessionTracking` trap §3.1, unbounded cardinality §5, averaged percentiles
  §6) ·
- `alerting-reviewer` (audits the alert/on-call surface — rate-without-floor
  §2.1, MWMBR correctness S6, `send_resolved` §8.2, `dedup_key` §8.5, dead tools
  §10.3, the delivery-path gap S5).

## The ID index (how to address the expertise)

- **S-IDs** (`S1`…`S18`) — `brain/BATTLE-TESTED-SCENARIOS.md`: real scenarios. `canary explain S5` = the page that never delivered.
- **§-IDs** (`§1`…`§12`) — `brain/KNOWN-PITFALLS.md`: version-specific footguns. `canary explain §1b.3` = `tracesSampleRate:1.0` in prod.
- **A-/B-/C-/D-IDs** (`A1`…`D5`) — `brain/OPINIONS.md`: taste stances. `canary explain A5` = never alert on a rate without a volume floor.

Query the brain: `canary brain "page never delivered"` →
`BATTLE-TESTED-SCENARIOS.md S5` + `OPINIONS.md A4`.
